name: serpapi_maps_search
description: Search Google Maps for places around coordinates, a map pin, or a map radius. Use for 'coffee near this pin', 'places open now near these coordinates', or map searches with price ranges, preferred minimum ratings, or opening day/hour constraints. Returns address, rating, hours, phone, website, and the effective provider filters. Price filters select overlapping place price ranges; minimum rating is a ranking preference and can still return lower-rated or unrated places. Use serpapi_google_local for 'near me' businesses without a map center and serpapi_yelp_search for Yelp filters.

query.description: Place or local search query. Example: coffee shops in Austin.

ll.description: Optional lat/lng bias for Google Maps. Example: @30.2672,-97.7431,14z

hl.description: Language code for Google Maps results (default: en).

device.description: desktop, mobile, or tablet. Default: desktop.

num_results.description: How many normalized results to return (1-10, default: 5).

min_price.description: Lower bound of the place's price range. Google returns overlapping ranges, not a guaranteed bill or per-person quote. Applies to places with numerical price data, such as restaurants.

max_price.description: Upper bound of the place price range; must not be below min_price. Google matches overlapping price ranges.

min_rating.description: Preferred minimum Google rating. A ranking preference, not a strict cutoff: lower-rated or unrated places can still appear.

open_state.description: Prefer places open now or open 24 hours. Cannot be combined with open_on_day or open_at_hour.

open_on_day.description: Day the place is open. Cannot be combined with open_state. Pair with open_at_hour for a specific hour.

open_at_hour.description: Hour the place is open, 0 (midnight) through 23. Requires open_on_day and cannot be combined with open_state.

no_cache.description: If true, bypass SerpApi cache for fresh fetch.

extra_params.description: Additional engine-specific query parameters passed through to SerpApi.

include_raw.description: If true, include full raw SerpApi payload in data.raw.

availability.setup_hint: Set SERP_API_KEY in the active mode env file.
